001package org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.playwright;
002
003import java.nio.file.Path;
004import java.util.Locale;
005
006import org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.common.telemetry.Telemetry;
007import org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.harness.Server;
008
009import com.microsoft.playwright.Browser;
010import com.microsoft.playwright.BrowserContext;
011import com.microsoft.playwright.ConsoleMessage;
012import com.microsoft.playwright.Page;
013import com.microsoft.playwright.Playwright;
014
015import io.opentelemetry.api.common.Attributes;
016import io.opentelemetry.api.logs.Logger;
017import io.opentelemetry.api.logs.Severity;
018
019/**
020 * A browser session of a {@link Browsing} body: the Playwright objects, steps, and screenshots.
021 */
022public final class Session {
023
024        /**
025         * The body of a step.
026         *
027         * @param <E> Exception type
028         */
029        @FunctionalInterface
030        public interface StepBody<E extends Throwable> {
031
032                void run() throws E;
033
034        }
035
036        private final Server server;
037        private final Options options;
038        private final Playwright playwright;
039        private final Browser browser;
040        private final BrowserContext context;
041        private final Page page;
042        private final Logger logger;
043        private int steps;
044        private int screenshots;
045
046        Session(Server server, Options options, Playwright playwright, Browser browser, BrowserContext context, Page page) {
047                this.server = server;
048                this.options = options;
049                this.playwright = playwright;
050                this.browser = browser;
051                this.context = context;
052                this.page = page;
053                logger = Telemetry.logger(server.openTelemetry());
054                page.onConsoleMessage(this::console);
055                page.onPageError(error -> Telemetry.log(
056                                logger,
057                                Severity.ERROR,
058                                Browsing.PAGE_ERROR_EVENT,
059                                error,
060                                Attributes.of(Browsing.URL_FULL, page.url())));
061        }
062
063        public Server server() {
064                return server;
065        }
066
067        public Options options() {
068                return options;
069        }
070
071        public Playwright playwright() {
072                return playwright;
073        }
074
075        public Browser browser() {
076                return browser;
077        }
078
079        public BrowserContext context() {
080                return context;
081        }
082
083        /**
084         * The page. Relative URLs passed to {@code navigate} resolve against the server's base.
085         */
086        public Page page() {
087                return page;
088        }
089
090        /**
091         * Runs the body in a span named after the step, with screenshots as the options say: before
092         * and after, after, or none. If the body fails, a screenshot of the failure is taken, and the
093         * failure is recorded on the span and rethrown.
094         */
095        public <E extends Throwable> void step(String name, StepBody<E> body) throws E {
096                int index = ++steps;
097                Telemetry.inSpan(Telemetry.tracer(server.openTelemetry()), name, Attributes.of(Browsing.STEP_INDEX, (long) index), span -> {
098                        if (options.stepScreenshots() == Options.StepScreenshots.BEFORE_AND_AFTER && !"about:blank".equals(page.url())) {
099                                take(name, "before");
100                        }
101                        try {
102                                body.run();
103                        } catch (Throwable failure) {
104                                if (!page.isClosed()) {
105                                        take(name, "failure");
106                                }
107                                throw failure;
108                        }
109                        if (options.stepScreenshots() != Options.StepScreenshots.NONE) {
110                                take(name, "after");
111                        }
112                        return null;
113                });
114        }
115
116        /**
117         * Takes a screenshot now, in the current span.
118         *
119         * @return The file
120         */
121        public Path screenshot(String name) {
122                return take(name, "explicit");
123        }
124
125        private Path take(String name, String phase) {
126                int index = ++screenshots;
127                String fileName = String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%03d-%s-%s.png", index, slug(name), phase);
128                Path file = options.screenshots().resolve(fileName);
129                page.screenshot(new Page.ScreenshotOptions().setPath(file).setFullPage(options.fullPage()));
130                Telemetry.log(
131                                logger,
132                                Severity.INFO,
133                                Browsing.SCREENSHOT_EVENT,
134                                name,
135                                Attributes.builder()
136                                        .put(Browsing.SCREENSHOT_NAME, name)
137                                        .put(Browsing.SCREENSHOT_PATH, fileName)
138                                        .put(Browsing.SCREENSHOT_PHASE, phase)
139                                        .put(Browsing.SCREENSHOT_INDEX, (long) index)
140                                        .put(Browsing.URL_FULL, page.url())
141                                        .build());
142                return file;
143        }
144
145        private void console(ConsoleMessage message) {
146                Severity severity = switch (message.type()) {
147                        case "error" -> Severity.ERROR;
148                        case "warning" -> Severity.WARN;
149                        case "debug" -> Severity.DEBUG;
150                        default -> Severity.INFO;
151                };
152                Telemetry.log(logger, severity, Browsing.CONSOLE_EVENT, message.text(), Attributes.of(Browsing.URL_FULL, page.url()));
153        }
154
155        /**
156         * A file name segment: lower case letters and digits, words joined by hyphens.
157         */
158        static String slug(String name) {
159                String slug = name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", "-").replaceAll("(^-+|-+$)", "");
160                return slug.isEmpty() ? "screenshot" : slug;
161        }
162
163}
